duplicateRouteMechanisms.finding: docs/all.astro links to /book/egov-vison and /book/egov-challenges (lowercase) while the chapter files are eGov-vison.mdx / eGov-challenges.mdx and book/index.astro GROUPS spells them with capital G/V. If Astro's default collection slug does NOT lowercase the "eGov" segment, these two links 404; if it does, then book/index.astro GROUPS (which uses the mixed-case spelling) silently fails to find them and they vanish from the /book index despite draft:false. Either way one of the two mappings is wrong. Unverified without a build — see GAPS.

Footer.astro devOnly links (not rendered in production): /book, /commentary, /ui, and the entire "Topics" section (the three deprecated /vision/<layer> preview pages plus 4 docs/ideas & book links). In production the footer has NO link to /book at all — the book index is reachable only from in-page CTAs on /, /why, /vision, /principles and cross-links inside chapters, never from global nav.

src/pages/docs/[...slug].astro generates a /docs/<entry.slug> route for EVERY non-draft docs collection entry, with no folder filter (entry.data.draft check only). This means every published book chapter is ALSO reachable at /docs/book/<slug> via this catch-all -- a live collision with the 10 explicit redirect wrapper pages at the same path (src/pages/docs/book/<slug>.astro), and every non-book docs entry (why, manifesto, index, all, reference/index, support/time-is-running-out, why/scale, and 10+ ideas/articles entries) gets a second URL under /docs/ that duplicates its dedicated page. Entries with a customSlug (european-english, language, why) get a THIRD alternate path (e.g. /docs/why-reforms). Whether the static wrapper or the dynamic catch-all wins the /docs/book/<slug> collision at build time is unverified -- see GAPS.

/book/principles (chapter, draft:false, title "Vision for European Cooperation and Integration") and /principles (page, "Guiding Principles for European Integration") are two different, partly-contradictory documents that share the word "principles". src/pages/docs/book/principles.astro -- the legacy redirect for the chapter -- sends readers to /principles (the page) instead of /book/principles (the chapter), which is either a bug or an admission that the chapter is meant to be superseded by the page.
